screen.title: Data Backup
screen.infoDescription: Exports are encrypted with a passphrase unless you explicitly opt out. Scheduled auto backups are always encrypted with your backup passphrase.
screen.exportDescription: Save all data to an encrypted backup file on your device.
screen.importDescription: Restore data from a backup file (.ikuyo or older .json). Existing data will be replaced.
screen.importWarning: All existing data will be deleted and replaced with backup data!
screen.autoDescription: Automatically back up your data on a schedule as encrypted .ikuyo files.
screen.autoEnabled: Auto backup is active — next run at {time}
screen.autoScheduleFailed: Failed to update the auto backup schedule. Please try again.
screen.currencyMissing: This backup does not say which currency its amounts are in. Nothing was imported. Choose the backup currency and try again.
screen.currencyUnsupported: This backup uses a currency format this app does not support ({code}). Nothing was imported.
screen.currencyLegacyWarning: This older backup does not record its currency. Choose the currency the amounts were saved in; amounts are not converted.

encryption.exportDescription: Choose a passphrase to encrypt this backup. You will need it to import the file.
encryption.passphraseTooShort: Passphrase must be at least {min} characters
encryption.unrecoverableWarning: If you forget this passphrase the backup cannot be recovered. It is not stored anywhere.
encryption.unencryptedWarning: The file will contain all your financial data in readable form. Anyone who gets the file can read it.
encryption.importDescription: Enter the passphrase used when this backup was exported.
encryption.wrongPassphrase: Wrong passphrase or the file was modified. Nothing was imported.
encryption.truncated: The backup file is incomplete or damaged. Nothing was imported.
encryption.unsupported: This backup was made with an unsupported format version. Nothing was imported.
encryption.notABackup: This file is not an Ikuyo backup. Nothing was imported.
encryption.tooLarge: This backup file is larger than the supported maximum of {max} MB. Nothing was imported. Choose a different backup file.
encryption.exportTooLarge: Your data is too large for a portable backup (maximum {max} MB). No file was written. Delete old data you no longer need, then try again.
encryption.legacyWarning: This is an old unencrypted backup. It can still be imported, but new exports are encrypted.

auto.setupDescription: Scheduled backups are encrypted with this passphrase. You need it to restore them on this or any other device. Only a key derived from it is kept in this device's secure storage, never the passphrase itself.
auto.setupWarning: If you forget this passphrase, your auto backups cannot be recovered. Changing it later only affects new backups; older files still need the old passphrase.
auto.pausedMissing: Set a backup passphrase to resume encrypted auto backups. Nothing is written until you do.
auto.pausedUnreadable: The saved backup key can no longer be read (for example after reinstalling or restoring the app). Set your backup passphrase again to resume. Nothing is written until you do.
auto.legacyNote: Older unencrypted auto backups (.json) are kept as they are and are never deleted automatically. Only the newest encrypted backups are rotated.
auto.keySetupFailed: The backup passphrase could not be saved securely. Auto backup was not changed and nothing is written unencrypted.
auto.keyClearFailed: Auto backup is off, but the saved backup key could not be removed.
